spec.context: Screen: REPORTS route opened signed-out (stack screen, back arrow top-left, title "Reports" 18px). Contract: EmptyState with file icon, title "Sign in to see your reports", grey caption "Your lab-test orders and their reports live here, tied to your account.", ONE black "Sign in" pill (ink PillButton 44px) that opens an auth bottom sheet. Judge: is the doorway calm and honest, one clear action, caption contrast on white, any truncation, alignment rhythm.

measured_notes: Title 'Sign in to see your reports' is the largest text on the surface (~17-18px bold, near-black on white) and reads first — hierarchy correct.
Caption 'Your lab-test orders and their reports live here, tied to your account.' is mid-grey (~#6B6B6B estimated) on white, contrast roughly 4.6-5:1, passes AA at ~14px.
Sign in pill is approximately 76x44-48px — height looks at or near the 44px minimum; width generous but it is the only action.
No truncation or ellipsis on any text; caption wraps cleanly across two lines.
Back arrow (~44px target) and 18px 'Reports' header title present top-left; content block is horizontally centered with consistent rhythm between icon, title, caption, button.
White canvas, no stray accent color, icon is grey in a light-grey circle — restraint law respected.
Empty state names the situation truthfully and gives exactly one next step (no dead end).
non_blocking_notes: Sign in pill appears near-black/ink rather than the dark ink described in contract — could verify it's the intended ink token, not a lighter grey.
Empty-state block sits in upper third; consider slightly more vertical centering for balance — cosmetic.
Sheet behavior (spring, grab handle, scrim tap) cannot be judged from a static screenshot; verify interactively.
verdict.one_line: Calm, honest signed-out empty state with one clear action, clean hierarchy, and AA-contrast caption; only interactive sheet behavior remains unverifiable from this frame.
